_doc: Maths grade curve (slice 9, 2026-11-13). Each tier is a band on the school-grade score from tools/balance/math_difficulty.py (1.0 = start of grade 1). Each topic names the tiers it may appear at, with the grades and the standards behind them (Common Core codes; the UK National Curriculum year where it places a skill earlier than Common Core). Read by math_difficulty.py, math_grade_curve.py, the quiz pipeline gate (tools/quizgen/deterministic/math_grade_band.py) and tests/test_math_grade_curve.py. The human table is docs/quiz/math_grade_curve.md.
